The [[City/Legends|city]] of '''Khar''' was located on the [[Khar Peninsula]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. On a large island in the [[Southern Ocean (Kalimahr)|Southern Ocean]], the city was comprised of seven skyscrapers, each more than a [[Meter|kilometer]]-high, and many other smaller ivory-colored towers that spread to the shores. In the eastern quadrant of the city was an abandoned [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu]] [[Stargazers Temple|temple]] built their own temple [[Stargazers]], receiving territory for use from the owner of [[Kara (Je'daii)|Kara]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
